The T18.rt_gpu_* cost figures are a result only where this is 1: every window of the interleaved cost measurement did what its kind says (pack taken by the rays, or hidden from them), every window has its GPU figure, and no one of the eight rounds of a kind lies more than max(0.15 ms, 3 %) from the kind's median. A window is 20 settling frames and 50 timed frames, its figure the median of the GPU's own stamps of the traced passes; the cost is the median over the rounds of (taps8 - hidden) of the same round. A valid measurement needs a quiet machine: no other process on the GPU (a Unity job or a second game moves the passes by ms), the vessel and the camera standing still, and a dxgi.dll that stamps the passes. The CPU frame times (T18.rt_ms_*) are information only: the game is CPU bound, so they cannot resolve a GPU cost of a fraction of a ms. 0 means it was not valid: the figures are then not to be used.
The largest distance of a round's window figure (median frame time) from the median of its kind, over the four kinds: the noise of the cost figure. Above 2 ms the figure is not valid.

THE COST of the own layers in the rays: the GPU's own milliseconds of the traced passes (the proxy's 'trace=' stamps, on while the probe sets rtGpuTimings=1 in the proxy ini) with the pack in the rays (rt.rayTaps 8) minus with the pack hidden, median over eight interleaved rounds of the pair of adjacent windows (50 timed frames each, median per window). The CPU frame time cannot show it: the game is CPU bound at about 30 ms a frame, so a few ms of extra GPU work hide behind the CPU and the window's frame time moves with the frame pacing (start 67: the layers 'saved' 1.2 ms). Valid only with T18.rt_cost_valid = 1.
The resolution reached: half the range of the eight paired deltas of taps8. A difference between two runs, or a cost, smaller than this is not resolved; the aim is plus or minus 0.3 ms.
The largest distance of a round's window figure (median GPU ms) from the median of its kind, over the four kinds: the noise of the GPU figure. Above max(0.15 ms, 3 %) the cost is not valid.
Windows without a GPU figure (fewer than 25 of the 50 frames carried one): the proxy did not stamp (an old dxgi.dll, or the ini not reread).
The GPU ms of the traced passes with the pack hidden from the rays (the median of the windows).
The same with the pack in the rays, rt.rayTaps 8.

INFORMATION: the longest single frame of all cost windows (a stall of the machine, not of the layers; the windows' medians ignore it).

From the switch to the first pack. EXPECTED: 5 to 20 s: the first bake runs at 6 ms a frame (rt.firstBakeBudgetMs) and costs 150 to 500 ms of the main thread, 30 to 100 frames of a traced scene. Start 65 measured 182 s at the former 0.25 ms a frame, which made the probe run past its 10 minutes.

EXPECTED: the main-thread time of one whole bake 150 to 500 ms (offline, Debug, four layers: 170 ms without and 520 ms with height variation at stride 2). Limit 800 ms (start 65: 1475 ms before the baker's near check and column loop were made cheap).
INFORMATION: real time from the start of the first bake to its pack (the pack's age when it stands).

The worst tick of the first bake (budget 6 ms plus the check interval of 64 texels, the first tick carries the JIT and the 4 MB allocation). The first bake happens once, when the switch goes on; the refresh ticks are T18.refresh_tick_worst_ms.
The worst tick of the bakes that keep a standing pack current (budget 0.3 ms plus the check interval of 64 texels). A tick above 2 ms is a hitch the refresh adds to a traced frame.

The main-thread time baking took per frame over the interleaved cost windows (about 1400 frames, the bake's own stopwatch): the cost of keeping the pack current. EXPECTED 0.2 to 0.3 (budget 0.3 ms a frame, the owner's limit for the own layers in the rays: 0.3 ms).
INFORMATION: uploads of the whole pack texture during the cost windows (one per finished refresh bake; the live fields go by a one-row copy).

[proposed] The largest age of the sky the standing pack shows (time since its bake began) over one whole refresh cycle. EXPECTED 20 to 80 s: the bake's main-thread time over the 0.3 ms a frame, in frames of a traced scene (40 to 60 ms). Start 65 had a pack 180 to 360 s behind the sky (continuous rebake at 0.25 ms). A bound that rises means the bake got dearer or the frames faster.
INFORMATION: real time of the last refresh bake from its start to its pack.
INFORMATION: main-thread time of the last refresh bake.
INFORMATION: the age of the standing pack at the moment of the agreement scans.
EXPECTED: at least the first bake is done when the first pack stands.

The first upload, which creates the 8 MB texture: the pack's data is copied as one block into the texture's CPU copy (no loop over the texels), then Apply. EXPECTED: 2 to 6 ms (start 66 with the per-texel expansion: 11.9 ms). Limit 8 ms.

The worst main-thread step of a refresh upload, which copies one layer slice (2 MB) a frame through a staging texture and a GPU copy: no frame uploads more than a quarter of the pack. EXPECTED: 0.5 to 2 ms. Limit 4 ms.
EXPECTED: every layer of the stack (up to 4) is in the pack. Brief: all layers.
EXPECTED: equal to the stack's layers, at most 4.
EXPECTED: 2 MB a layer at 512 x 256 on the graphics card (four floats a texel, the proxy cannot share two; 8 MB for four layers).
EXPECTED: the texture is Width x (Height x layers + 1 header row).

EXPECTED: at least 20 places of the 41 x 41 lattice (+-4 degrees, step 0.2) where the field or the ray is neither fully clear nor fully dark (T between 0.02 and 0.98).

90th percentile of |T_ray - T_field| over the lattice, sun 45 degrees, the pack that stands. T is the share of the sun's light, so 0.10 is a ground 10 percent of full sunlight too dark or too light at the worst tenth of the places that are not clear or dark in both. The limit is the pack's own residual on the game's maps, not an age allowance: start 67 gave 0.092 for the standing pack (age 18 s) and 0.090 for a pack baked in the same call, so age adds 0.003 here. The residual is the pack's stride-2 depth (the full depth and the band of the odd texels are interpolated between nodes, and they are strongly non-linear in the type where neighbouring texels differ much); offline on fine cells it is 0.01 to 0.06 at stride 2 and 0.00 to 0.04 at stride 1 (T18.scan45_fresh_stride1_p90 is the game's figure for stride 1, which costs 2.5 times the bake). A relative figure is not used (it is large and invisible where T is near 0).

[proposed] worst place of the lattice, sun 45 degrees, |dT|. Offline 0.14 to 0.19 on smooth maps; on maps with fine cells (two to four texels, neighbouring texels of very different type, where the pack's band and column depth are blended per texel and the field's from the blended type) up to 0.45. Start 66, before the column depth cap and the cloud band were fixed: 0.98. The scan45_worst_place_* lines of the start show, per layer, what both sides read at the three worst places.

The median of tau_ray over tau_field (tau = -ln T) at the places with T between 0.1 and 0.9, sun 45 degrees. EXPECTED 0.95 to 1.05 (offline 0.95 to 1.04). A factor of two in a layer's depth (a layer twice, not at all, a scale error) or a wrong frame moves it to 2 or 0.5; the slab model does not.
As scan45_p90 for a pack baked in the call that reads the stack: the model alone, without the age of the standing pack (the same limit: the figure is the pack's residual, see scan45_p90).

As scan45_worst for the fresh pack, with the same limit 0.5. The worst places are columns beside a steep edge of a thick cloud: the cumulonimbus' full depth is 370 to 460 there and its share at the edge changes from 0.1 to 1 within a texel, so a stride-2 interpolation of the depth and the base and top between nodes is off by a factor of several at the one texel where the ray crosses the flank. Start 67: standing 0.398, fresh 0.386 (the worst-place lines of the start show the layer: cumulonimbus tau field 0.11, pack 0.85, texel cover 0.11, tau_full 456).
INFORMATION: p90 for a pack baked in the call with the depth at every texel (rt.depthStride 1): what the 2.5 times dearer bake buys.

INFORMATION: the main-thread time of the stride-1 bake in one call (the stride-2 one is T18.fresh_bake_ms).

INFORMATION: how far the cloud pattern moves in the age of the standing pack: the mean wind 3 km up at the vessel times the pack's age at the scan. A shadow edge that moves this far changes T by its slope times it.
INFORMATION: p90 over the lattice of |T_standing - T_fresh| (two packs, no field): what the pack's age cost.
INFORMATION: p90 of |T_fresh(place) - T_fresh(place + the wind's drift over the age)|: the change the drift alone makes to the shadow, i.e. what the age is expected to cost.

p90 of |T_standing(place) - T_fresh(place + the wind's drift over the age)|: the standing pack with its age taken out by the wind. A pack that is old only by the wind's drift is the fresh pack moved, so this is near the pack's own residual or below; a figure above 0.06 means the age costs more than the drift explains (the maps change by growth and decay, or the wind used is not the layers').
